parts: [shouting] FUCK! [annoyed] The table is uneven, so it wobbles.
[proud] So I nail the whole table to the ground. [smug] Genius.
[confused] Wait... now my floor keeps fucking wobbling. [deflated] Fuck.
[determined] So I reinforce the floor into the rest of the house...
[shouting] What the fuck, now my whole house is wobbling! [sarcastic] Fucking... awesome.

parts.t: [deadpan] Meanwhile, my cat is fucking not impressed.

parts: [determined] So I bolt my whole house to the fucking earth.
[panicked] Now the whole fucking planet is shaking!
[nervous] And my cat is looking at me with a pissed off expression.
[determined] So I bolt the planet to the sun... and the sun to the fucking galaxy. [proud] Now the whole universe wobbles... so technically, the table doesn't.
[surprised] The cat took the table in the divorce... [relieved] fucking sweet.
